checked: atomic reject supplies 0 and preserves pre-event management state
partial complete supplies 12, resets interval state, persists no residual backlog
partial residual-active supplies 12 and persists residual 8 as explicit management state
partial complete and residual-active have identical current water but different future event demand
accepted finalize commits supplied water and management candidate together
rollback rejects both water and management candidate together
full supply collapses all policies to the same completed event
allocation/realization shortfall is diagnostic unless explicitly promoted to residual state
